title: Text: DET Mike Russell ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: How is it looking for you guys? With the hurricane

Left at 2am this morning from Lakeland.Easy drive till Tallahassee and traffic was heavy from there. Moved a bunch of stuff from garage. Hoping for a easterly track tomorrow. We have a place in North Pensacola to go tomorrow. Take care my friend!
Me too. Good luck and be safe. Talk soon.
